sloka: केचिद् वैहायस गताः सुपर्णा इव पुप्लुवुः ।घोषेण महता घोषम् सागरस्य समुच्च्रितम् ॥६-२२-८४॥।।
transliteration: kecid vaihāyasa gatāḥ suparṇā iva pupluvuḥ ।ghoṣeṇa mahatā ghoṣam sāgarasya samuccritam ॥6-22-84॥।।

translations.english: The terrific sound caused by the frightening advancement of massive monkey troops the sound of the ocean got drowned.
